title: Why medicine shows skipped New Orleans; meeting Creath and Zutty in St. Louis
summary: Shows avoided New Orleans, and Joe first met Charlie Creath and Zutty when the show played near St. Louis in 1925.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: There never seemed to be many medicine shows that I know of that went in through New Orleans. Why didn't they go through New Orleans?
New Orleans was too big a city.
You mean the people were more sophisticated and wouldn't go for that baloney?
Now you've got it. But you'd find them across the river...

Around Algiers and all them other little old towns, in Reserve or... Any little town. Because we played East St. Louis, and I would get tired of staying on that bus, and we'd come into St. Louis. That's how I happened to meet Charlie Creath and Zutty and them guys around there, in 1925.
We're going to get to that a little bit later. Let me just pursue this a bit further with Doc Moon.
